description: Server-side image resolution seam for the headless facade (TempoDocumentRenderRequest.ImageResolver): resolves an image reference (asset id / URL) to an embeddable data URI before layout, so headless exports embed real images — the counterpart of the browser's IDocumentImageUrlResolver. Return null to leave the reference unresolved; its footprint then renders as a placeholder rectangle. Hosts should prefer asset-backed images for server-rendered exports; host-relative URLs are not resolvable on the server.
